column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
So... why Akihabara?
It's a otaku pilgrimage.
Huh.
This time, it's not that side of me, it's this other side!  The anime I saw recently had a scene from this place!
Ahh, your hidden side--your otaku side, you mean. Well, certainly you could go anywhere with your model friends except this one place.
Yeah, right? And then I turned down the Black one and the Swirly Glasses' invitations too.
So, which way? Since it's you, you checked it out, right?
Of course!  That way, that way!
As I followed behind Kirino to the site, the otakus around us grew in number.
Ah!  People are posing for the pictures.
Oh yeah. It looks really popular. Is it really that famous, that anime?
Oh hey, that's the same pose from the most memorable scene! I wanna do it too!
...She didn't listen... Hey, you're really going to do it?!
Of course! Why do you think we came here?
Well, fine then. Alright, get in line.
Okay!
Kirino, who only listens in these situations, lined up. Finally, her turn came.
Of course, it meant the one who had to take the picture with her cell phone was me.
Okay, take it properly!
Alright, alright. I guess it'll be totally different than that earlier photography for the modelling jo--hey, wait a sec!
While Kirino gave orders, she took a pose that was... quite racy.
Well, to explain it simply, it was erotic. Incredibly.
H-Hey!  What's with that pose?!
What are you doing?  Hurry up and take it!
That... I mean, you're...
HUR-RY-UP!
Okay, okay!  I got it!
Ah, yes.  That's...
How perceptive.  The scene from the last episode where the girl appeared again. No doubt about it.
Very skilled eyes there.
One shot for reference.
Huh?!
The otakus around Kirino started to take pictures.
And what's more, because one person took a photograph, the others instantly aimed their cameras at Kirino and started taking pictures.
Then, as the situation fell into chaos, even those who would lie down on the ground to take low angle shots appeared!
Uh, hey... no... c'mon!
Isn't this what's called, 'You reap what you sow?'
Though Kirino was used to being photographed, in front of an uncountable number of lenses even she would feel scared.
She looked at me with desperate eyes.
Geez... I guess I gotta do something...
C'mon, this way!
Ah!
I grabbed Kirino's arm and dragged her into a nearby cafe.
